Jordan: Quick sync — Snow + DBX + Qdrant connector launch timing question. Are we still aiming for Apr 10 marketplace listing + joint announcement?
Priya: Yes on timeline but marketing needs one firm embargo window. Propose Apr 10 11:00 PT.
Sam: Engineering update: connectors pass basic e2e, need final perf matrix from Databricks test harness by Apr 5.
Liam: Sales heads-up: we have 3 pilot customers we'd like to name. Legal ok with quoting logos?
Maria-legal: Can review permissions; need customer opt-ins and boilerplate by Apr 6.
Priya: Marketing checklist — we need: logo lockups, co-branded screenshots, joint blog draft, 90s demo clip, one-pager, and press contact list. Who owns the demo video?
Sam: Eng will produce the demo clip but need stable staging creds and the final connector build. Planning a smoke-run Apr 7.
Jordan: Also coordinating with HW partner for on-prem demo (DGX). Need confirmation of hardware availability and an ops aide for soak testing.
wayne-hwpartner: DGX reserved Apr 5–9 for Redwood. Can run soak and help with driver install. Ping me for SFTP keys.
Liam: Field kit: playbook + FAQ + pricing notes — I'll draft by Wed. Need two product screenshots from Priya.
Priya: I'll get screenshots and draft blog outline by Apr 3. Also want a single embargo time so marketplace listings go live simultaneous.
Jordan: Can we align marketplace listing hours across Snowflake, Databricks, and Qdrant marketplaces? Ops constraints?
Sam: Technically fine if we coordinate exact metadata and assets ahead of time. Databricks needs the hashing of the connector bundle by Apr 6.
Maria-legal: I'll sign off on co-marketing copy if final assets are in by EOD Apr 4.
Jordan: Action items (summary):
- Sam: final perf matrix + connector bundles by Apr 5
- Maria-legal: customer/legal sign-off by Apr 6
- Priya: assets + embargo schedule by Apr 7
- Wayne: confirm DGX ops + SFTP credentials
- Liam: field enablement kit by Apr 8
Sam: Adding test command for the dry run so SI and QA can reproduce: 
```
make e2e-run CONNECTORS="databricks,snowflake,qdrant" PROFILE=prod-staging 
LOG_LEVEL=info 
```
Priya: Good; can we schedule a full dry-run (marketing + eng + legal + hw) on Apr 8 10:00 PT?
Jordan: Yes. I'll send calendar and invite SI.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: https://calendar.company/evt/2098765432-dryrun — attendees: Jordan, Priya, Sam, Liam, Maria-legal, wayne-hwpartner
